description: This file defines a custom Glide module for configuring image loading behavior in an Android app, specifically custom cache clearing logic.

classes.name: CustomAppGlideModule
classes.description: A custom Glide module that extends AppGlideModule and provides a method to clear Glide's cache asynchronously.

methods.name: registerComponents
methods.description: Registers Glide components, calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears Glide's memory and disk cache, with disk cache clearance executed on a background thread.
